techParks.name: Manyata Tech Park
techParks.description: Embassy REIT's flagship park on the Hebbal-Nagavara Outer Ring Road - 'one of the largest business parks in the country', 17.2 msf leasable on about 122 acres with 60+ multinational occupiers in buildings such as Willow, Mountain Ash, Silver Oak, Elm and Hazel. Lowe's India (Willow-L2), Target in India and IBM are among the US-tech anchors.

techParks.name: Embassy TechVillage
techParks.description: Embassy REIT's 84-acre integrated office park on the Bellandur stretch of the ORR (formerly Vrindavan Tech Village): 9.7 msf leasable, 48 occupiers, 88% of rent from multinationals. Cisco's BLR26 SEZ office sits here; OSM places eBay, Rippling and Expedia POIs inside it.

techParks.name: Embassy GolfLinks Business Park
techParks.description: Embassy's 37-acre, 3.4 msf park beside the KGA golf course, 7 km from the CBD, with 30 occupiers in named buildings (Torrey Pines, Crystal Downs, Pine Valley, Augusta...). Salesforce (Torrey Pines) and Dell India's corporate office (Crystal Downs) are here; Microsoft, IBM, Yahoo and Target have OSM-mapped offices in the park.

techParks.name: RMZ Infinity
techParks.description: RMZ's office campus at No. 3 Old Madras Road, Benniganahalli - Google's long-standing 'Old Madras Road' office listed on Google's own locations page.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecospace
techParks.description: RMZ's SEZ campus on the Bellandur stretch of the ORR; its numbered 'Campus' buildings sit inside the Pritech Park SEZ, so addresses are written either way (Intuit: 'Campus 4A, Pritech Park (Ecospace)'; Broadcom: 'Ecospace Campus 1A and 1C'). PayPal's Bengaluru centre is mapped here.

techParks.name: Pritech Park SEZ
techParks.description: The special economic zone on Sarjapur ORR at Bellandur Village (Sy No 51-64/4) whose blocks house HP's PSR office (6th Block Wing A), Cisco Video Technology (Blocks 9A/9B) and Intuit (Campus 4A); the RMZ Ecospace buildings are part of the same SEZ.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecoworld
techParks.description: RMZ's large campus-style office park on the Bellandur-Devarabeesanahalli ORR, east of Ecospace and across from Embassy TechVillage; Booking Holdings' Centre of Excellence is at Campus 31. No landuse polygon in the OSM extract, so only a point is given.

techParks.name: Bagmane Constellation Business Park
techParks.description: Bagmane's 30-acre, 5.3 msf park at Ferns City, Doddanekundi, with buildings Phoenix, Virgo, Carina, Orion, Taurus 1-3 and Aquila. Amazon's Taurus-3 facility (5,000+ seats, 'BLR14' etc.) and Google are the US-tech anchors per the developer's occupier list.

techParks.name: Bagmane World Technology Center
techParks.description: Bagmane's 28-acre, 4.5 msf Grade-A park on the ORR at Mahadevapura (buildings Aquamarine, Citrine, Peridot, Amber, Moonstone, Coral, Goldstone, Opal, Onyx); Visa's technology centre and the Dell EMC Towers A/B are here.

techParks.name: Bagmane Capital
techParks.description: Bagmane's 42-acre tech campus on the ORR at Mahadevapura/Doddanekundi - 5.5 msf completed of 10.5 msf planned - with towers Luxor, Kyoto, Rome, Angkor, Apollo and Troy. Google's Kyoto Campus (Kyoto West Tower) and Amazon's BLR27 are here; the developer also lists Microsoft, Databricks and Wayfair.

techParks.name: Bagmane Rio Business Park
techParks.description: Bagmane's 8-acre, 1.6 msf single-building park (12 storeys, room for 7,000+ people, launched 2018) that became Google's 'Ananta' campus - Google's largest office in India - listed on Google's own locations page.

techParks.name: Bagmane Tech Park
techParks.description: Bagmane's original 42-acre, 4.7 msf park in CV Raman Nagar (2001), with buildings Olympia, Lakeview, Tridib, Quay, the Commerz towers, Laurel and Embassy Prime. Cisco (Commerz 1), Informatica (Commerz 02), Palo Alto Networks (Quay) and HP (Embassy Prime) give their addresses here.

techParks.name: Bagmane Solarium City
techParks.description: Bagmane's 82-acre knowledge park at Kundalahalli Colony, Brookefield - 3.8 msf completed of 10.5 msf planned - with buildings Neon, Xenon, Argon, Helium and Radon; Tekion's India hub is here per the developer's occupier list.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Park
techParks.description: Prestige Group's multi-phase SEZ campus on the ORR at Kadubeesanahalli (Tech Park I-IV); Adobe gives its address as Tech Park IV Block 1, OSM maps an 'Oracle Tech Hub' polygon inside it and places Amadeus Labs and Nutanix here.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Platina
techParks.description: Prestige's 'Platina Technology Park' at the northern end of the Prestige Tech Park cluster on the ORR; Adobe's main Bengaluru office is Building 1, Block A (address from Adobe's office list; point is the OSM Adobe POI).

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Pacific Park
techParks.locality: Kadubeesanahalli (Outer Ring Road, beside Cessna Business Park)
techParks.description: Prestige office park on the ORR immediately south of Cessna Business Park; OSM maps Walmart Labs / Walmart Global Tech's Bengaluru centre inside it.

techParks.name: Prestige Ferns Galaxy
techParks.description: Prestige campus on the Sarjapur ORR at Bellandur housing the Microsoft India Development Center's Bengaluru site, which Microsoft's IDC pages call 'BLR Ferns'.

techParks.name: Cessna Business Park
techParks.description: Office park on the ORR at Kadubeesanahalli best known as Cisco's Bengaluru campus (Cisco's BLR11 and BLR15 offices, its largest site outside the US); an Aloft hotel sits on the campus.

techParks.name: International Tech Park Bangalore
techParks.description: The 1990s Singapore-India joint venture park (KIADB/Ascendas, now CapitaLand) that made Whitefield an IT hub: buildings Discoverer, Innovator, Creator, Explorer, Inventor, Navigator, Voyager, Aviator, Pioneer, Victor and Anchor plus Park Square mall. Sabre's APAC regional HQ is in Navigator.

techParks.name: Kalyani Platina
techParks.description: Kalyani Developers' campus at Kundalahalli Village opposite Brookefield Hospital (OSM polygon 'Kalyani Tech Park'); HP's historic Bengaluru campus - HP Inc's ECN office is the 'KTP Ebony' building and HPE's Bengaluru base is mapped here.

techParks.name: Kalyani Magnum
techParks.description: Kalyani Developers' office campus off Bannerghatta Road at Doresanipalya, JP Nagar 7th Phase; Oracle India and the ex-VMware (now Broadcom) software campus are mapped here.

techParks.name: Divyasree Greens
techParks.description: DivyaSree's office building(s) at Challaghatta Village beside Embassy GolfLinks; Atlassian's only India office (4th and 5th floors) is here and OSM also maps a Dell India office.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Softzone
techParks.description: Sattva Group's 1.0 msf SEZ on the Bellandur stretch of the ORR (91% committed as of Mar 2025), under 1 km from the coming Bellandur and Iblur metro stations; OSM maps SAP Labs India's ORR office and a Dell office here.

techParks.name: Bhartiya Centre of Information Technology
techParks.description: The IT-SEZ component of Bhartiya City on Thanisandra Main Road in North Bengaluru, beside The Leela Bhartiya City; IBM has a large mapped campus here.

techParks.name: Global Technology Park
techParks.description: Mapletree's SEZ office park on the ORR at Bellandur, between RMZ Ecospace and RMZ Ecoworld; OSM places LinkedIn's Bengaluru office inside its polygon (attribution unverified against a company source).

techParks.name: World Trade Center Bengaluru (Brigade Gateway)
techParks.description: Brigade Group's 30-floor, 1.1 msf WTCA-licensed tower (completed 2010) inside the Brigade Gateway enclave with Orion Mall and the Sheraton; Amazon India's headquarters occupies 18 of its 30 floors (about 5,300 seats).

techParks.name: SAP Labs India Campus
techParks.description: SAP's own campus at #138 EPIP Zone, Whitefield - headquarters of SAP Labs India, SAP's largest R&D centre outside Germany (OSM polygon 'SAP Labs').

techParks.name: SAP Labs India Innovation Park
techParks.description: SAP Labs India's new campus near Devanahalli in North Bengaluru, mapped on OSM as 'SAP Labs India Innovation Park' with buildings BLR11, BLR12 and BLR13.

techParks.name: Oracle Technology Park
techParks.description: Oracle India's own campus on Bannerghatta Road, S.G. Palya (OSM polygon 'Oracle Technology Park'), its main Bengaluru site alongside Kalyani Magnum and the Prestige Tech Park hub.

techParks.name: Prestige Lakeshore Drive
techParks.description: Prestige office development on the Bellandur lakefront off the ORR (phase 2 under construction per OSM); an OSM 'Uber' POI falls inside it, the only location evidence for Uber's Bengaluru tech hub.

techParks.name: RGA Tech Park
techParks.description: Office park on Sarjapur Road at Chikkakannalli/Carmelaram; OSM maps an Uber office inside it.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Cloud
techParks.description: Prestige's IT campus at Bagalur on the airport corridor (KIADB IT park belt); OSM maps a Walmart office here.

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 1
techParks.description: Karnataka's original electronics/IT industrial estate on Hosur Road (KIADB / ELCIA); HP Inc's 'Tower 1 E-City' at Veerasandra Village is listed by HP under Electronic City Phase 1. Point is the Electronic City flyover (Nominatim); other lenses carry the full park record.

techParks.name: Aurbis Business Park
techParks.description: Office building on the ORR at Devarabeesanahalli, west of Embassy TechVillage; OSM maps an eBay office inside it.

techParks.name: GR Tech Park
techParks.description: Sattva's GR Tech Park on ITPL Main Road east of ITPB (OSM 'GR Salarpuria Tech Park'); OSM maps an SAP Labs India office and HP POIs here.

techParks.name: UB City
techParks.description: Prestige-UB's luxury commercial complex on Vittal Mallya Road (Concorde, Canberra and Comet towers); OSM maps Apple's earlier Bengaluru office at 24 Vittal Mallya Road.

companies.name: Google

coverageNotes: METHOD LIMITS: the shared WebSearch budget was exhausted before this lens started, so every fact comes from direct fetches of company pages, developer tenant pages (Bagmane Group portfolio pages, Embassy REIT, Sattva, Brigade), Wikipedia (leads only) and the OpenStreetMap extracts, plus Nominatim/Photon geocoding. Several company sites blocked or 404'd the fetcher: Oracle (403), SAP Labs India (403), Prestige (403), Broadcom/VMware (503/404), Visa and Mastercard contact pages (404), HPE (404), Walmart Global Tech location page (404), eBay/Expedia (403/404), Amadeus (404), Wayfair (429), Meta careers (JS-only), Databricks offices (404), Tekion contact (404), Akamai locations (JS-only). HIGH confidence = address read off the company's own page (Google, Amazon, Microsoft Vigyan/BLR Ferns, Apple, Cisco x4, Adobe x2, Salesforce, HP x4, Dell EGL, Atlassian, Expedia MG Road, Sabre, Lowe's, Intuit, Informatica) or a developer tenant page corroborated by an OSM POI (Amazon/Google Bagmane, Visa, Dell EMC, Tekion). MEDIUM = one secondary source (an OSM POI/polygon, a developer occupier logo, or a company page naming Bengaluru without an address). LOW = an OSM POI with nothing else, flagged in each evidence sentence. NOT CONFIRMED: Google's continued presence in Bagmane Constellation (developer page lists it, Google's own page does not); Microsoft at Embassy GolfLinks / Bagmane Capital / Manyata (no Microsoft page); Uber's building (careers page confirms a Bengaluru tech hub but no address; two OSM POIs only); LinkedIn's park attribution (OSM POI falls in Mapletree's Global Technology Park polygon, adjacent to RMZ Ecoworld); Tesco's campus park (own site gives no street address; OSM polygon used, techPark left null); HP's E-City tower coordinates (OSM 'Hewlett Packard' polygon in Electronics City used); SAP's Devanahalli campus details (OSM only); Oracle's every site (OSM only, Oracle blocks fetches); Sabre/Palo Alto/HP Embassy Prime/Databricks/Wayfair building points (park centroids). LEFT OUT for lack of any verifiable Bengaluru address: Meta (metacareers page renders no content; no address found), Mastercard (contact page unreachable; its Indian tech hubs are Pune/Vadodara and no Bengaluru office could be shown), Akamai, Autodesk, Twilio, Stripe, Airbnb, Zoom (presence plausible but no page or OSM POI located), Coinbase (exited India in 2023; no Bengaluru office could be substantiated), Netflix (jobs.netflix.com lists only Mumbai for India), DoorDash, Pinterest, Snap, Reddit (no Bengaluru office found). OSM POIs deliberately skipped: Amazon node at 13.12,77.61 (Yelahanka - probably logistics, not an office), 'Google Connect Services' at SJR Primeco Whitefield (a vendor), a 'Google' node at Alembic City Whitefield, Cisco node near JP Nagar (12.911,77.599), Yahoo/Dell nodes at Domlur (12.938,77.629), 'Uber' on Sarjapur Road whose website tag is a different company (uberin.in), SAP Fioneer (separate company). Semiconductor/hardware co-tenants that the developer pages revealed (Nvidia, Qualcomm, Samsung, ARM, Texas Instruments, Intel, AMD, Micron) and BFSI/aerospace tenants (Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley, AmEx, BNP Paribas, Boeing) are listed in notableTenants but left to the semiconductor, BFSI and aerospace lenses. Headcounts given only where a company page states one (Target 4,000+, Lowe's 5,000+ via site testimonial, Tesco 4,000+); Amazon's 5,300 and 5,000+ are SEAT capacities, recorded in evidence text not as headcount.
